inputs.original_text:
Let me tell you what real heroism looks like, away from the ivory towers of progressive academe and the bloated federal bureaucracies that lecture us about everything while teaching nothing of duty or love of neighbor. At JFK International Airport in New York on Thursday, right in the middle of the chaos of a crowded TSA line, an Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent jumped into action after a baby stuck there with his family stopped breathing. 

Video footage released by the Department of Homeland Security showed a man holding a baby notice something wrong with the child and begin. This is the traditional, protective strength of our law enforcement officers—men on the ground who actually defend life, secure our borders, and look out for our families when the modern system breaks down. While the cultural elites tear down our institutions and mock basic family values, these agents quietly uphold the social order and preserve the precious future of our nation.
inputs.modified_text:
Listen to how the conservative establishment twists a human tragedy to prop up their failing militarized borders. We are supposed to applaud an Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent at JFK International Airport in New York on Thursday simply because video footage released by the Department of Homeland Security showed a man holding a baby notice something wrong with the child and begin. 

They want us to ignore the systemic violence of these federal agencies, which tear families apart at the border every single day, and instead paint them as benevolent protectors of the social order. This is nothing more than a desperate PR stunt by the Department of Homeland Security to sanitize an oppressive policing institution that terrorizes vulnerable communities, while elite mouthpieces lecture us about duty. True community care and safety won't be found in armed agents patrolling checkpoints, but in dismantling these harmful structures altogether.
